name: Morphing Polygon
css:
.loader { --accent: var(--loader-color); --accent-2: var(--loader-secondary-color); width: var(--loader-size); height: var(--loader-size); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2)); animation: morph calc(var(--loader-speed) * 3) ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes morph { 0%, 100% { clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0% 75%, 0% 25%); transform: rotate(0deg); } 33% { clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%, 0% 0%); transform: rotate(120deg); } 66% { clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 50% 0%, 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%, 0% 100%); transform: rotate(240deg); } }
